description: Internal diagnostics classes for PDFsharp library, including parser and content reader diagnostics with exception handling and error reporting.

classes.name: NotSupportedBehavior
classes.description: Enumeration defining behaviors for unsupported features: DoNothing, Log, LogError, Throw.

classes.name: ParserDiagnostics
classes.description: Static class providing methods for parser error handling and exception throwing.

classes.name: ContentReaderDiagnostics
classes.description: Static class providing methods for content reader error handling and exception throwing.

methods.name: ThrowParserException
methods.description: Throws a PdfReaderException with a message, optionally with an inner exception.

methods.name: HandleUnexpectedCharacter
methods.description: Handles unexpected character in PDF stream, throws exception with detailed message.

methods.name: HandleUnexpectedToken
methods.description: Handles unexpected token in PDF stream, throws exception with detailed message.

methods.name: CannotFindEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles case where end of stream cannot be found, throws exception.

methods.name: ThrowContentReaderException
methods.description: Throws a ContentReaderException with a message, optionally with an inner exception.

methods.name: ThrowNumberOutOfIntegerRange
methods.description: Throws exception when a number is out of integer range.

methods.name: HandleUnexpectedCharacter
methods.description: Handles unexpected character in content stream, throws exception with detailed message.
